cards.pika_rain: 2015 JP XY-P Art Academy Pikachu in a red raincoat with an umbrella, illus. Y. Fujishima (pokumon.com scan)
cards.mewtwo: Base Set Mewtwo 10/102 (stand-in for Gempire's $108,000 example; its text names Mewtwo sales)
cards.zard_base: Base Set Charizard 4/102 (stand-in for the $336,000 example)

hall.open_sides: +z; nothing between z -4.3 and the lens in the two locked frames

scenes.vo: Một lá Pikachu mặc áo mưa được bán với giá tám triệu tư đô la, rồi biến mất khỏi danh sách đã bán.
scenes.gloss: A raincoat Pikachu sold for 8.4 million dollars, then vanished from the sold list.
scenes.viewer: A huge sale, and then its record falls off the wall.
scenes.build: reuse:stage, rostrum, lot column with the REAL raincoat Pikachu slab; new: bid board; new: sold wall with the hero ticket (SOLD $8,400,000).
scenes.blocking: Auctioneer front view behind the rostrum at his mark, gavel raised from frame 0.
scenes.action: f0-62 the gavel is held up (wind-up held, a 1 cm tremble). f63-68 a beat of stillness, f69 strike (2 f before 'tám'): the board's TOTAL snaps to 8,400,000 and the SOLD lamp lights; the slab hops 4 cm. f78-122 the camera travels right along the back wall to the sold wall; f118 the hero ticket's pin pops out (it pings off and drops), f120-134 the ticket slides down the cork and drops into the 8 cm gap behind the filing cabinet on 'biến mất'. A pale clean rectangle stays on the cork where it hung, the pin lies on the cabinet top.
scenes.acting: Auctioneer: stern, then a grin after the strike.

cams.why: travel along the wall to the record

scenes.physics: gavel: 1 f down, 3 f rebound. Pin: pops 3 cm out and falls onto the cabinet top (bounces twice). Ticket: slides 0.6 m down the cork face in 12 f (paper on cork: 2/3 g), tips into the gap and is gone by f134.
scenes.sound: held breath room tone; gavel crack f69 with a low boom; Kaching meme f72; pin ping f118, paper slide f120-134, a soft thud in the gap f134.
scenes.after: The pale rectangle on the cork and the pin on the cabinet (seen again in S05).

scenes.vo: Tháng chín, trên sàn Fanatics Collect, sáu mươi tư lượt trả giá, búa gõ ở bảy triệu, cộng phí thành tám triệu bốn trăm nghìn.
scenes.gloss: In September, on Fanatics Collect: 64 bids, the hammer at seven million, with fees 8.4 million.
scenes.viewer: How the price was made: bids, hammer, fees.
scenes.build: the locked stage frame: date plate, bid board, auctioneer, the slab on column A. Paddles rise into the bottom of the frame from bidders below the frame.
scenes.blocking: Auctioneer at his mark. Bidders are below the frame; only their paddles (on 25 cm handles) rise into it.
scenes.action: f176-185 the date plate flaps to THÁNG 9 · 2026. f254-296 paddles flick up at the bottom of frame (left, right, centre, 9 lifts) while BIDS counts 0 -> 64. f305 the gavel rises; f325 strike (2 f before 'bảy'): HAMMER 7,000,000. f349 PREMIUM +1,400,000 lights; f362-394 TOTAL rolls up to 8,400,000; f394 the SOLD lamp.
scenes.acting: Auctioneer: stern; a grin after the strike.

cams.why: close on the board for the fees

scenes.physics: paddles: up in 4 f, held 6 f, down in 5 f.
scenes.sound: flap clatter f176, bid murmur, paddle whooshes, digit ticks, gavel crack f325, cash-register roll f362-394, Kaching meme f394.

scenes.vo: Báo chí khắp nơi đưa tin: lá Pokémon đắt thứ hai lịch sử.
scenes.gloss: The press everywhere reported it: the second most expensive Pokémon card in history.
scenes.build: new: kiosk, counter, three newspaper bundles with front pages.
scenes.blocking: No people: bundles are thrown in from the delivery van off screen left.
scenes.action: Three tied bundles land on the counter on arcs from screen left: f414 ('Báo'), f428 ('chí'), f445 ('đưa'), each a thud with a hop and a settle; fanned in a pile, the third on top; their front pages: PIKACHU $8.4M (EN), PIKACHU 8,4 M$ (FR), PIKACHU 8,4 TRIỆU ĐÔ (VI), each with the real raincoat Pikachu and a big No.2. f470 push in on the top page as the line lands on 'đắt thứ hai'.
scenes.physics: bundles: ballistic arcs (0.5 m up), land, one 3 cm hop, settle; twine holds.
scenes.sound: street ambience, three paper thuds, a printing-press rumble under, a newsroom chime f482.

scenes.vo: Cuối tháng mười, hồ sơ ghi rõ: đã thanh toán.
scenes.gloss: At the end of October the record says clearly: paid.
scenes.build: the locked wall frame: calendar, the sold wall with every ticket and the hero ticket back on its pin (this is before it fell), the cabinet.
scenes.blocking: Clerk front view at his mark left of the board, a rubber stamp in his right hand.
scenes.action: f533-541 the calendar flips to 10 · 2026. f578-586 the clerk winds the stamp back, holds it to f589, f591 thumps it onto the hero ticket (2 f before 'đã'): a green PAID stamp appears, a small ink burst. He lifts the stamp away by f600 and nods.
scenes.acting: Clerk: neutral, a small satisfied smile after the stamp.
scenes.physics: stamp: 3 f down, 1 f squash, 4 f up.
scenes.sound: calendar flip f533, office hum, stamp thump f591, a soft ding.
scenes.after: PAID stamp stays on the hero ticket.

scenes.vo: Rồi giữa tháng mười một, trang của nó biến mất. Rồi hiện lại.
scenes.gloss: Then in mid-November its page disappeared. Then it came back.
scenes.viewer: The record vanished, then came back.
scenes.build: the locked wall frame; the tube light flickers (cold).
scenes.blocking: Clerk at his mark with the yardstick in his right hand, held down along his leg.
scenes.action: f637-645 the calendar flips to 11 · 2026. f693 the hero ticket's pin pops; f694-707 it slides down and drops into the gap behind the cabinet on 'biến mất'; the pale rectangle again. f708 the clerk looks down at the gap; f712-722 he crouches and slides the yardstick into the gap; f724 he flicks: the ticket pops up out of the gap on 'hiện' (arc 0.75 m), and f733 the stick's tip presses it back onto the cork, a little crooked; f738 a new pin. He straightens up.
scenes.acting: Clerk: nervous when it falls, effort on the fish, relief after.

cams.why: down a little to the gap and the stick

scenes.physics: ticket: as in S01; the pop-up is a ballistic arc with spin, damped when the stick tip meets it.
scenes.light_mood: day, colder: the tube flickers at f636, f650.
scenes.sound: calendar flip f637, tube buzz and tick, pin ping f693, paper slide, wood scrape f712-722, flick f724, pin push f738.
scenes.after: The hero ticket hangs a little crooked on a new pin.

scenes.vo: Lần này, dữ liệu ẩn bên trong trang ghi đúng một chữ: đã hủy.
scenes.gloss: This time, the hidden data inside the page says exactly one word: cancelled.
scenes.viewer: On the side nobody looks at, it now says CANCELLED.
scenes.build: macro on the hero ticket; its lower right corner curls up and shows the back, where a red CANCELLED stamp sits.
scenes.action: f752-790 the camera pushes in on the ticket (PAID still on its face). f800 a draught (the door off screen right) lifts the loose lower-right corner, which flutters twice (f800-826). f830-838 stillness, the corner half up. f839 ('đã') the corner curls fully: the back shows a red rubber stamp CANCELLED, on 'hủy' f856 the camera punches in.
scenes.physics: corner: a paper flap hinged on its diagonal; draught pushes it up in two flutters (damped spring), then it curls past 150 deg and stays.
scenes.light_mood: day, cold; the tube flickers once at f838.
scenes.sound: air hiss f800, paper flutter, silence f830-838, Realization Sound meme f839, low hit f856.
scenes.after: The corner stays curled, CANCELLED showing (S07, S14).

scenes.vo: Khoan, vậy rốt cuộc có ai trả tiền không? Mà đâu chỉ riêng Pikachu.
scenes.gloss: Wait, so did anyone actually pay? And it's not just Pikachu.
scenes.viewer: Collectors don't know what to believe; and there are many more records.
scenes.build: the hall in front of the sold wall; the three collectors in the left foreground.
scenes.blocking: The three collectors stand left of the line of sight, front view, heads turned toward the wall (facing screen right).
scenes.action: f868 ('Khoan') all three freeze mid-step (nervous). f892-930 dB leans in (crouch 0.1, head tilt), dA scratches nothing: holds still; f951 ('không?') dC tilts his head, dazed. f967 ('Mà đâu chỉ riêng') the camera pulls back and up to the whole wall: dozens of tickets.

cams.why: their faces with the wall behind

scenes.sound: music drops out f868; Huh meme f951; a soft riser f967.
scenes.after: The collectors stay off to the left (out of frame).

scenes.vo: Trang tin GempireCards ngồi so từng kết quả đấu giá cũ với lịch sử bán hiện tại của Fanatics, và thấy hàng triệu đô doanh số Pokémon đã lặng lẽ bốc hơi.
scenes.gloss: GempireCards compared old auction results with Fanatics' current sales history, and found millions of dollars of Pokémon sales had quietly evaporated.
scenes.viewer: Someone checked, and many records are simply gone.
scenes.build: the sold wall wide; the writer with a thick binder (cover: AUCTION RESULTS, printed tabs).
scenes.blocking: The writer walks in from screen left (side view, +x) f1008-1046 to his mark, then front view, binder held open at his chest with both hands (cover to us), eyes going between the binder and the wall.
scenes.action: f1081-1100 eyes down (binder), f1104-1125 up and right (the wall), f1128-1150 down, f1153-1176 up. f1193 ('thấy') shock. f1270-1296 on 'bốc hơi' six tickets steam off in a wave from left to right: each one curls, fades to white and rises as a steam curl, leaving its brass pin and a pale rectangle on the cork.
scenes.acting: Writer: focused, then shock with his jaw dropping a little (gape 0.4).
scenes.physics: steam: each curl rises 0.5 m in 20 f, widening and fading; the paper shrinks to nothing in 10 f.
scenes.sound: footsteps f1008-1046, binder pages, a pencil scratch; six soft hisses f1270-1296, a kettle-whistle swell under 'bốc hơi'.
scenes.after: Six pale rectangles with bare pins.

scenes.vo: Những lá từng chốt giá một trăm linh tám nghìn, ba trăm ba mươi sáu nghìn đô, giờ như chưa từng được bán.
scenes.gloss: Cards that once closed at 108,000 and 336,000 dollars now look as if they were never sold.
scenes.viewer: Big sales gone, without a trace.
scenes.build: close on two tickets side by side: Base Set Mewtwo $108,000, Base Set Charizard $336,000 (real scans).
scenes.action: f1343 the Mewtwo ticket steams off on 'một trăm'; f1376 the Charizard ticket on 'ba trăm'. f1430-1462 ('giờ như chưa từng'): the pale rectangles darken to match the cork and the pins pop out and drop: clean cork, as if nothing ever hung there.
scenes.physics: pins: pop 2 cm out, fall out of frame.
scenes.sound: two hisses f1343 f1376 with a cash-register 'no sale' clunk under each; two tiny pin pings f1440 f1446.
scenes.after: Clean cork where those eight tickets were.

scenes.vo: Fanatics giải thích: không nhận được tiền thì giao dịch bị xóa khỏi lịch sử, để thông tin thị trường được chính xác.
scenes.gloss: Fanatics explains: if the money isn't received, the transaction is deleted from the history, so that market information is accurate.
scenes.viewer: The rule: unpaid means removed, neatly.

out.note: match: the ticket's shape becomes the stake sign

scenes.build: the clerk at the board's lower left; the shredder; the spirit level.
scenes.blocking: Clerk front view at mark clerk10.
scenes.action: f1488-1500 he unpins the lower-left ticket (it carries a red UNPAID stamp). f1540-1570 he turns to the shredder and holds it over the slot; f1573 ('xóa') the shredder grabs it: it is pulled down into the slot by f1590 and strips drop behind the window. f1600-1620 he lays the spirit level along the top edge of the bottom row; its bubble slides from the left end to the centre on 'chính xác' f1640; he gives a small satisfied nod.
scenes.acting: Clerk: matter-of-fact (neutral), a small smile at the level.
scenes.physics: ticket into the slot: pulled at 0.25 m/s; strips fall in the bin.
scenes.sound: pin pull f1490, shredder grind f1573-1592, a bubble 'ding' f1640.
scenes.after: The bottom-left spot is empty; the level stays on the row.

scenes.vo: Nhưng bạn thấy đấy, giá thẻ bài cũng giống giá nhà.
scenes.gloss: But you see, card prices are like house prices.
scenes.build: the street: five houses on the left, five stake signs at the same height, all $300K.
scenes.blocking: The agent stands on the near lawn beside sign 0, the SOLD rider in her hand.
scenes.action: Golden calm. A slow push down the street.

scenes.vo: Một căn được báo bán đắt, cả khu phố lập tức nâng giá theo.
scenes.gloss: One house is reported sold high, and the whole street raises its prices at once.
scenes.viewer: One big sale lifts every neighbour's price.
scenes.build: the SOLD rider hooks under sign 0 (red, SOLD $900K); the neighbours' signs rise on their stakes and their prices roll up.
scenes.action: f1776-1784 she swings the rider up, f1786 ('bán') hooks it under sign 0 with a clack: SOLD $900K. f1810, 1818, 1826, 1834 the four neighbour signs shoot up their stakes one after another (0.75 -> 1.7 m, 6 f, overshoot 8 cm, settle), each price rolling $300K -> $450K, $480K, $520K, $560K.

cams.why: up a little to see the wave

scenes.physics: signs: spring rise, 6 f up, 8 cm overshoot, 6 f settle; stakes stay in the ground.
scenes.sound: rider clack f1786, four ascending boings f1810-1834 (pitched up each time).

scenes.vo: Đến lúc con số bị xóa, cả thị trường đã kịp chạy theo một mức giá có khi chưa từng được trả.
scenes.gloss: By the time the number is erased, the whole market has already chased a price that may never have been paid.
scenes.viewer: Remove the sale, and the raised prices stay.
scenes.build: sign 0 pulled out of the lawn; the other signs and all the signs of the two streets behind stay high.
scenes.action: f1878-1888 she grips sign 0's stake and yanks it out of the lawn on 'xóa' (a puff of dirt, a hole), f1890-1904 tosses it flat onto the lawn behind her. f1905-1990 the camera cranes up: every other sign on this street and on the two streets behind stands high.

cams.why: crane up: the whole market stays high

scenes.physics: the sign: pulled up 0.4 m, tossed on an arc, lands flat, one bounce; dirt puff.
scenes.sound: dirt rip f1886, a thump f1904, a long low synth pad for the crane.

scenes.vo: Có thể chỉ là lỗi dữ liệu. Fanatics chưa giải thích.
scenes.gloss: It may only be a data error. Fanatics hasn't explained.
scenes.build: the sold wall with its gaps, the hero ticket with its curled corner; the office door.
scenes.blocking: Clerk at his mark, front view; then side view walking +x to the door.
scenes.action: f2023-2046 ('lỗi dữ liệu') he shrugs, both arms out. f2050-2088 he walks right to the office door (side view), f2084 the door swings open (inward), f2090 he steps through into the dark, f2096-2102 the door swings shut on 'giải thích'; the CLOSED tag on the knob swings and settles by f2110.
scenes.acting: Clerk: neutral, shrug, avoids eye contact.
scenes.physics: door: swings on its hinge, slams, 2 small rebounds; the tag is a pendulum (2.2 Hz, damped).
scenes.sound: footsteps, door creak f2084, slam f2100, tag tick-tick.

scenes.vo: Và lá Pikachu áo mưa vẫn được gọi là lá đắt thứ hai thế giới, kèm một chữ nhỏ không ai đọc: đã hủy.
scenes.gloss: And the raincoat Pikachu is still called the second most expensive card in the world, with a small word nobody reads: cancelled.
scenes.viewer: The legend stays; the truth is in the small print.
scenes.build: the dark gallery, the case on its plinth, the plaque; four visitors with phones flanking it.
scenes.blocking: Visitors front view at their marks, turned toward the case (facing inward), phones held up at face height.
scenes.action: Phones flash (f2120, 2134, 2151, 2163, 2178, 2196). f2124-2200 the camera pushes in past the visitors to the card. f2200-2240 it tilts down the plinth to the plaque: No.2 MOST EXPENSIVE POKEMON CARD, $8,400,000. f2256-2290 it pushes in on the last line, tiny: 'cancelled', landing on 'đã hủy' f2285-2300. Hold.
scenes.light_mood: dark gallery, one warm spot on the case.
scenes.sound: gallery hush, phone shutters with each flash (Camera shutter), music swell then out at f2280; Suspicious Sound meme f2300.
